messages:
Anya: quick check — I'm about to change terraform for the telemetry namespace: moving the SOPS secret path from `s3://redwood-telemetry/staging` -> `s3://redwood-telemetry/telemetry-v2`. TF plan shows the IAM role ARN will be replaced. Will this break the k8s SA IRSA wiring? anyone seen surprises here?
Mike: short answer: possible if manifests/helm still point at the old annotation. New pods will try to assume the new role; old pods keep using old creds until restarted. Update the SA annotation `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`.
Sam: also double-check the role trust policy — must allow `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` and the `Condition` on `sts:sub` should match `system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:<sa>` exactly. Namespace change = trust policy change.
Anya: we're managing SA via helm chart. Should I change `values.yaml` `serviceAccount.annotations` or patch SA after TF apply?
Jordan: change the helm values so the chart owns the SA. Example snippet to add in values.yaml:
```
serviceAccount:
  create: true
  name: telemetry-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/telemetry-v2-role
```

InfraBot: deploy-bot: terraform plan shows replacement of IAM role `telemetry-role` -> `telemetry-v2-role`. No drift detected for current SA manifests.
Mike: also watch SOPS mount paths — if you rename the secret or move it to another bucket/prefix the init container that decrypts may fail with `open /etc/sops/creds.yaml: no such file or directory`. Update `extraSecretMounts` in the chart.
Sam: one more gotcha: if you update the role ARN but the IAM role isn't usable for the SA yet (missing trust policy update or missing OIDC mapping), pods will fail assume role with `AccessDenied`. Best to apply IAM changes first, verify `aws sts get-caller-identity` from a test pod using the new SA, then roll workloads.
Anya: good call. I'll do a canary: create a temporary SA in the same ns with the new annotation and spin a debug pod to run `aws sts get-caller-identity`. If that passes I'll update helm values and bump chart.
Jordan: extra tip — if you're changing namespace or moving secrets between namespaces, update `StringEquals` in trust policy to the new `system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<sa>` and add both old+new during a transition window.
Anya: planning to open a PR that contains: TF IAM role changes + helm chart values bump + chart `values.yaml` update for secret mounts + short rollout plan. Pinging @Mike for review when ready. :pray:
Mike: SGTM, ping me on PR and I'll do a quick pass. small nit: increment chart `appVersion` and include a note in changelog about credential migration. :thumbsup:
Anya: thanks — will do. I'll also add a smoke job to the CI that runs `kubectl exec` into a pod using the test SA to validate creds post-deploy.
Sam: if you want I can help with the IAM trust policy snippet. lmk.
Anya: appreciate it, Sam. I'll assign you on the PR for the policy change.
Jordan: one last suggestion — enable a short `readOnly` mode in the chart for the first rollout so writes are limited if something goes wrong.
Anya: noted. thanks everyone, opening PR now.
